dialogue.22500: Heh, I can defeat a pig with a single toenail! I am a Dragon, you know.
dialogue.22501: I'm so weak from hunger, I couldn't even defeat a pig. The pig would probably end up eating me... I feel so weak...
dialogue.22502: Look for the word 'impossible' in the dictionary and you'll see a picture of a Dragon eating grass. I refuse to eat it. It's gross! Bleh!
dialogue.22503: Ugh... My stomach... I feel sick.
dialogue.22504: Dad probably knows something that can help us! Huh? It's weird that I call him Dad? But what else would I call him? Your dad is my dad, Master.
dialogue.22505: The Dairy Cow might be a little scary... Just saying...
dialogue.22506: Ahh, so full. Hmm, didn't Dad say he wanted to tell us something?
dialogue.22507: Yeah, that explanation was a little wordy. To sum it up, you and I share the same destiny.
dialogue.22508: Ha! Strange Pigs aren't so different from normal Pigs. I can defeat them with one wing tied behind my back.
dialogue.22509: Haha, I defeated the Strange Pigs! I'm awesome! We better go tell Dad!
dialogue.22510: So this is what a town looks like. Wow! So many people... And they're all so busy!
dialogue.22511: So this is what helping people is all about!
dialogue.22512: Let's help people who are in trouble! I'm sure this town is full of folk who need help.
dialogue.22513: Train! Train! Traaaiiiin! Choo, choooo! Let's train, Master!
dialogue.22514: Power B. Fore, from the Hill East of Henesys... Strange name...
dialogue.22515: Eh, that Power B. Fore guy is kind of a weirdo.
dialogue.22516: Cynical Orange Mushrooms! Cynical Orange Mushrooms! What does 'cynical' mean anyway?
dialogue.22518: What kind of oddball would raise Spores? Seriously...
dialogue.22519: Ribbon Pigs? Bah! They'll topple to the ground if I just poke them with my pinky.
dialogue.22521: You and I are heroes, Master! What? That deed wasn't significant enough to make us heroes? Psh, big or small, it's the thought that counts. Let's just call ourselves heroes!
dialogue.22523: Everyone in town knows the Master! Awesome!
dialogue.22524: Whoa, this puppet has some seriously bad mojo. You feel it?
dialogue.22525: If he's snoozing here, then who's standing guard?
dialogue.22526: A Guard isn't as impressive as a hero, but it's still an important job. Of course, I'd love to do it. Besides, who says we can't be both?
dialogue.22533: Argh! I hate to leave things hanging. I need closure. I won't be able to rest until we catch the culprit. Nella better contact us soon!
dialogue.22537: Of course I'm curious about me, but I'm more curious about my race. Where are all the other Dragons?
dialogue.22546: Onyx Dragons... Where are they? They have to be around somewhere...
dialogue.22548: A talking puppet! How bizarre! What? It's bizarre to hear a Dragon talk? No, it's not. You're silly!
dialogue.22552: I'm so glad we cleared up Sabitrama's misunderstanding. Only morons jump to conclusions. What do you mean I do it all the time?
dialogue.22553: Hmm, that puppet is actually very nice. I didn't expect that.
dialogue.22554: The folks in your hometown don't know you very well, Master. Not nearly as well as I do. It's kind of sad...
dialogue.22557: Phew, I'm so glad everything turned out okay. What a relief!
dialogue.22558: That door with the puppet on it is a big problem. What can we do? Hmm...
dialogue.22559: Hehehe. That was remarkably heroic, if I do say so myself.
dialogue.22560: A secret organization of people who do good deeds? Awesome! I'll be like one of those superheroes that hide their identites. Bat-Mir! Mir-verine! IronMir! Ooooh, I really want to join!
dialogue.22561: This organization is truly secretive. It's hard to join, because it's so selective!
dialogue.22563: Since I gave you one of my precious scales, we'd better find out more about Onyx Dragons.
dialogue.22564: Onyx Dragons are extinct...? But why? How?
dialogue.22565: No. How can Onyx Dragons be extinct when I'm right here? Uh-uh. There have to be other Onyx Dragons somewhere!
dialogue.22566: Yay, we're in! We're in! We're part of the secret organization!
dialogue.22567: This secret organization is more secretive than I imagined... What's the point of being so secretive when you're just helping other people?
dialogue.22569: A clue about Onyx Dragons? Let's ask, Master! Right now!
dialogue.22570: Go, go, go! To Lith Harbor! To John! He might know something about my race!
dialogue.22571: I can't wait to find others like me!
dialogue.22575: Another super secret mission from a super secret organization...
dialogue.22578: Hmm, how is that strange creature, Shammos, related to the secret organization? I can't figure it out.
dialogue.22579: Let's rush to that island where the Dragons live, Master!
dialogue.22580: At least now I know there's another dragon out there. I can wait longer if I have to. We'll be reunited someday. I just know it.
dialogue.22581: Ah, so the mystery of the secret organization is revealed! Sort of... But there's still so much I don't understand.
dialogue.22585: I've got a bad feeling about this mission. Is it all in my head?
dialogue.22586: What the... It's our fourth mission and we're still only temporary members?
dialogue.22589: What in the world just happened?! I don't understand what's going on...
dialogue.22590: That Dragon talked to me! I'm sure of it!
dialogue.22591: Master, I wasn't able to look into his memory. Tell me! Tell me!
dialogue.22592: Those Black Wings... They tricked us! They destroyed my species! I will never forgive them...

1202008.d0: Wolves only speak when it's absolutely necessary.
1202008.d1: Wolves only speak when it's absolutely necessary.

1202009.name: Wolf Guard
1202009.d0: My boss tells me that wolves never speak carelessly.
1202009.d1: My boss tells me that wolves never speak carelessly.

1202010.name: Pudin

1202010.d0: I've been awaiting the arrival of the ultimate hero!
1202010.d1: I've been awaiting the arrival of the ultimate hero!

1202011.name: Purin
1202011.n0: There is always construction going on in Rien. It's so loud all the time.
1202011.n1: The huge polearm excavation was a riot.
1202011.d0: Rien is covered in snow. You just never know what treasures are hiding under it. Puririririn!
1202011.d1: Rien is covered in snow. You just never know what treasures are hiding under it. Puririririn!

1203000.name: Sir Blacksmith
1203000.n1: A fine weapon always recognizes a fine owner...
1203000.d0: Haha! When will I ever get to find the rightful owner of Maha?
1203000.d1: Please take care of Maha for me.

1203001.name: Tititi
1203001.n1: Yeti... Yeti... Wait. What was Yeti going to say?

1209000.name: Athena Pierce
1209000.d0: We must leave before the Black Mage comes!
1209000.d1: We must leave before the Black Mage comes!

1300000.name: Mushking
1300000.s1: King Pepe, I won't let you get away with this!

1300001.name: King Pepe
1300001.s0: The Mushking Empire will one day be mine!
1300001.d1: I'm the new king in town!

1300003.name: Secretary of Domestic Affairs
1300003.s0: We must reclaim the palace at once.
1300003.s1: Where's the hero that's supposed to help us?
1300003.d0: We must reclaim the palace at once.
1300003.d1: Where's the hero that's supposed to help us?

1300004.name: Secretary of Magic
1300004.d0: We must reclaim the palace at once.

1300005.name: Head Security Officer
1300005.s0: King Pepe, I certainly will not let you get away with this!
1300005.d0: King Pepe, I certainly will not let you get away with this!
1300005.d1: I must protect his royal highness, the Mushking.

1300006.name: Prince Giuseppe
1300006.d1: Dad, what do I do now?

1300007.name: Scarrs
1300007.s0: Mushroom research is just so fun!
1300007.s1: Henesys is the capital of mushroom research.
1300007.d0: Mushroom research is just so fun!
1300007.d1: Henesys is the capital of mushroom research.

1301000.name: Thorr
1301000.n1: See if you need any recovery items.

1302000.name: Mushking
1302000.d0: Those who want to marry my daughter and become the next king of the Mushking Empire should accept my challenge.
1302000.d1: Our empire has found peace thanks to you, and so I shall allow your marriage to my daughter Violetta.

1302001.name: Violetta
1302001.d0: If being beautiful is a sin, then I am the greatest sinner of them all.
1302001.d1: Oh... So many mushrooms have come for me, but I really...

1302002.name: Violetta
1302002.d0: Heeya! Hiya! Hooya! Faster than everyone and totally unique!
1302002.d1: Oh, but I am also quite sad that I am so weak! What can I do? I was born this way!

1302003.name: Violetta
1302003.d0: I can't believe it! The Prime Minister is my... my father?
1302003.d1: I can't believe it! The Prime Minister is my... my father?

1302004.name: Prime Minister
1302004.d0: Why are you looking at me? I assure you, I do not look like anyone you know.
1302004.d1: I'm quite embarrassed about how much time I've wasted. I will work hard for the Mushking Empire from now on.

dialogue.30069: This is all because of that incompetent king! I'm just sad I could not get my revenge for my child!
dialogue.30072: I cannot believe Violetta is my daughter... What have I done?!

1302005.name: Prime Minister
1302005.d0: *Sob* That utterly bizarre Viking did this to me for talking about Violetta! But why? She's so beautiful!
1302005.d1: *Sob* That utterly bizarre Viking did this to me for talking about Violetta! But why? She's so beautiful!

1302007.name: Head Security Officer
1302007.d0: It won't happen again! I'm not that easy!
1302007.d1: Hero, you are pretty scary. I h-hope I didn't do anything to get on your bad side.

1302010.name: Gamma and Omega
1302010.d0: Melt Princess Violetta's frozen heart with a touching serenade! Who will? We will!
1302010.d1: No one truly knows music. That is why they can't appreciate REAL music. How can anyone call us tone-deaf? Really?

1302011.name: Mikhail
1302011.d0: I feel like I was born more invisible than others.
1302011.d1: Do you think I'm invisible too? Excuse me, hello? Can you see me?

1302012.name: Ghostie
1302012.d0: Don't call me Casanova, that's too weak. How about 'love thief'?
1302012.d1: Do you think I just got rejected? No, no, no. That's not right. Princess Violetta is just playing hard-to-get.

1302013.name: Anne Nah
1302013.d0: Are you a fan of Princess Violetta too? Then how about joining her fanclub?
1302013.d1: Oh, Princess Violetta is beautiful even when she's cold!

1302019.name: Black Viking
1302019.d0: Respect my preferences! I suffer from Resting Beauty Face Syndrome.
1302019.d1: Respect my preferences! I suffer from Resting Beauty Face Syndrome.

1302020.name: James
1302020.d0: S-Save me! I'm scared. I want to go home...
1302020.d1: S-Save me! I'm scared. I want to go home...

1302021.name: Thorr
1302021.d0: Pick and choose, whatever you want. Hey, you! Just take a look!
1302021.d1: Hey... I already told you, no exchanges or refunds.

1400000.name: Cristophe
1400000.s1: Store your important items here and take them out from any other Storage vendor!
1400000.s2: Good salary! Beautiful women! What a perfect job!
1400000.s3: How much is this ship anyway? Looks pretty pricey!

1400001.name: Serge
1400001.s0: A ship this great has to have the best weapons on the planet.
1400001.s1: I'll make sure you never regret a purchase.
1400001.s3: Good weapons are a lot better than jewels.

1400002.name: Mathias
1400002.s0: I'm a man of my honor. I will always return a favor.
1400002.s1: In return for your help, have at my wares.

1400003.name: Renault
1400003.n0: The wind is still. This is the perfect weather for a day in the skies!
1400003.n1: I love the sound of that engine!
1400003.d0: You wish to chart a new course? Just point toward the horizon!
1400003.d1: You wish to chart a new course? Just point toward the horizon!

1401000.name: Gaston
1401000.n0: You will never find a speck of dust upon the Lumiere, thanks to our wonderful maids.
1401000.n1: Shall I bring you some tea, master?
1401000.d0: A true butler knows his master's needs before he does.
1401000.d1: A true butler knows his master's needs before he does.

1401001.name: Christiane
1401001.n0: There are experts in every field and I am an expert in analyzing information.
1401001.d0: Information must be cataloged, analyzed, and processed before it becomes useful.
1401001.d1: Information must be cataloged, analyzed, and processed before it becomes useful.

1401002.name: Colette
1401002.n1: Nothing gets me more excited than a juicy new piece of intel!
1401002.d0: Brokering intelligence between nobles was such a bore. Working here is much better!
1401002.d1: Brokering intelligence between nobles was such a bore. Working here is much better!

1401003.name: Marguerite
1401003.n1: I never thought I'd have so much fun cleaning.
1401003.d0: I can't even remember why I was so hesitant to leave home and find a job. I love it here!
1401003.d1: I can't even remember why I was so hesitant to leave home and find a job. I love it here!

1401004.name: Madeleine
1401004.n1: A clean training center means better training sessions.
1401004.d0: I'm so glad I can be with my younger sisters. Thank you for taking care of us all!
1401004.d1: I'm so glad I can be with my younger sisters. Thank you for taking care of us all!

1401005.name: Marianne
1401005.n1: Can I get you something to drink? A sandwich?
1401005.d0: After I'm done with work, I can read my books with a nice glass of tea. This job is the best!
1401005.d1: After I'm done with work, I can read my books with a nice glass of tea. This job is the best!

1402000.name: Gaston
1402000.d0: All preparations complete. The only thing left is to carry out your plan. I bid you good luck, master.
1402000.d1: All preparations complete. The only thing left is to carry out your plan. I bid you good luck, master.

1404000.name: Francis
1404000.d0: Forget everything... I'm just going to make puppets. Leave me alone!
1404000.d1: Forget everything... I'm just going to make puppets. Leave me alone!

1404001.name: Lilin
1404001.d1: I never imagined one of the heroes would be so... ordinary. I had always imagined someone bigger and scarier.

1404002.name: Aran
1404002.d0: Thank you for helping. That's about all I can do. I'm sorry.
1404002.d1: Thank you for helping. That's about all I can do. I'm sorry.

1404005.name: Lotus
1404005.d0: (This gentle boy doesn't look like he could hurt a fly, but you can tell that his true form is lurking deep within.)
1404005.d1: (This gentle boy doesn't look like he could hurt a fly, but you can tell that his true form is lurking deep within.)

1404006.name: Mu Young
1404006.d1: Why... why does my head hurt?

1404007.name: Lotus
1404007.d0: (The person in the glass chamber doesn't look conscious.)
1404007.d1: (The person in the glass chamber doesn't look conscious.)

1404008.name: Cygnus

1404015.name: Aria
1404015.d0: (You see a beautiful girl with a faint smile, but it appears to be some sort of illusion.)
1404015.d1: (You see a beautiful girl with a faint smile, but it appears to be some sort of illusion.)

1500000.name: Cootie the Really Small
1500000.n0: The fairy culture is so much more advanced than ours...
1500000.n1: Where are all my research notes? And my fairy comics?!
1500000.d0: I am Cootie, and I am just the right size.
1500000.d1: I am Cootie, and I am just the right size.

1500001.name: Headmistress Ivana
1500001.n0: My students are my top priority.
1500001.n1: The pupils here will become the future leaders of our people.

1500001.d1: The Ellinel Fairy Academy is dedicated to educating fairies in the traditional fashion.

1500002.name: Faculty Head Kalayan
1500002.n1: As long as the students are safe.
1500002.d0: Yes, I am Faculty Head Kalayan.
1500002.d1: Yes, I am Faculty Head Kalayan.

1500003.name: Woonie the Fairy
1500003.n0: Ellinel is my home away from home...

1500004.n0: Do you know any stories about heroes?

1500005.n0: I'm too popular for my own good!

1500009.n1: I can't believe how exactly the same all the teachers are!

1500011.d1: Those precious fairies are in danger!

1500012.d1: Those precious fairies are in danger!

1500020.name: Phiny the Fairy

1501001.d1: I could really use some beauty sleep.

1501003.d0: I just love singing! And I'm so good at it too!
1501003.d1: I just love singing! And I'm so good at it too!

1501004.d1: My melodies flow through the spring waters and bring comfort to Elodin.

dialogue.37172: Thank you so much for bringing my baby back to me.
dialogue.37177: I'm sure my baby bird will improve with practice.

1501006.name: Shula
1501006.n0: Do you want to store something?
1501006.n1: Do you want to store something?

1501007.name: Baby Bird
1501007.n0: Would you like to hear me sing?
1501007.n1: Don't you think my singing's great? I do!
1501007.d0: I just love singing! And I'm so good at it too!
1501007.d1: I just love singing! And I'm so good at it too!

1501008.name: Ruenna the Fairy
1501008.d0: I could really use some beauty sleep.
1501008.d1: I could really use some beauty sleep.

1510000.name: Putan
1510000.d0: I am Putan, mightiest of penguins.
1510000.d1: I am Putan, mightiest of penguins.
1510000.n0: I am Putan, mightiest of penguins.
1510000.n1: The seas have grown fat as an orca, yes?

1510001.name: Pushki
1510001.d0: Don't be the only sardine out of the school, that's what I say!
1510001.d1: Don't be the only sardine out of the school, that's what I say!
1510001.n0: I used to hate seaweed, but then it grew on me.
1510001.n1: I'm on a see-food diet right now.

1510002.name: Alviola
1510002.d0: I can't stand by here watchin' good folks run outta food, don't ya know?
1510002.d1: I can't stand by here watchin' good folks run outta food, don't ya know?
1510002.n0: Ya do things good the first time, and ya don't have ta do 'em again.
1510002.n1: That smell in the air sure does make the fur stand up, don't it?

1510003.name: Alvesh
1510003.d0: I am the watcher in the snow...
1510003.d1: I am the watcher in the snow...
1510003.n0: When our glaciers melt, who will be our hero?

1510004.name: Dabo
1510004.d0: We must keep our eyes open, or somebody else'll do it for us, won't they?
1510004.d1: We must keep our eyes open, or somebody else'll do it for us, won't they?
1510004.n0: Doesn't this telescope make me look cool? I saw a dog what had one an' thought I should get me own.
1510004.n1: I spend lots of time makin' sure I don' look silly.

1510005.name: Dachi
1510005.d0: I love voyages almost as much as I love a fatty tuna.
1510005.d1: I love voyages almost as much as I love a fatty tuna.
1510005.n1: The sea is where me heart is.

1510006.name: Helmsman Tanya
1510006.n1: Ahoy, little squid! Ready to cast off?

1510007.name: Nora the Explorer
1510007.d0: This whole glacier is like one big history book! Let's read it together!
1510007.d1: This whole glacier is like one big history book! Let's read it together!
1510007.n0: The only way to learn is to dive right in!

1510008.name: Frostwitch Barbara
1510008.d0: You don't even got the sense to eat before you go out adventurin', do ya?
1510008.d1: You don't even got the sense to eat before you go out adventurin', do ya?
1510008.n0: Eat somethin' before ya freeze, ya knucklehead.
1510008.n1: You idiots belong up Zakum's behind!
1510008.n2: Ya wouldn't know what to do with a weapon enhancement if it bit ya.
1510008.n3: I'll fix you bird-brains somethin' to eat...
1510008.n4: I ain't no witch! Let an ol' broad enjoy her fancy hat in peace.
1510008.n5: Me a witch? Might as well call the snow a sundae and get yerself a spoon.
1510008.n6: Ya been jammin' white potions up yer nosehole?
1510008.n7: Finish yer food and get back in yer canoe!
1510008.n8: This old bird's just as tough as she ever was.
1510008.n9: Life's too short to be squabblin'.

1510009.name: Lilin
1510009.d0: People with like goals should work together.
1510009.d1: People with like goals should work together.
1510009.n0: Please don't make me wait too long.
1510009.n1: We're all in trouble if that glacier melts any more.

1511001.name: Puro
1511001.n0: Come see me when you want to return!

1513000.name: Ship Wreckage 1
1513000.d0: This pile of flotsam and jetsam had to have come from somewhere...
1513000.d1: This pile of flotsam and jetsam had to have come from somewhere...

1513001.name: Ship Wreckage 2
1513001.d0: There might be something useful in this pile of rubbish.
1513001.d1: There might be something useful in this pile of rubbish.

1513002.name: Ship Wreckage 3
1513002.d0: This wreckage looks newer than the rest...
1513002.d1: This wreckage looks newer than the rest...

1514002.name: Nora the Explorer
1514002.n0: Save me! I still have to pay off my student loans!
1514002.n1: How am I supposed to learn with all these monsters around?!

1520000.name: Sugar
1520000.d0: Maybe I'm too chicken to be an Explorer.
1520000.d1: I've been stuck here for hours.
1520000.n1: Maybe I should just close my eyes and run.

1520001.name: Rondo
1520001.d0: Please don't talk to me without good reason.
1520001.n0: What to do, what to do?
1520001.n1: I need time to mentally prepare myself.

dialogue.32248: What the...? You have too much time on your hands!

1520002.name: Rondo
1520002.d0: Is this Grandis? Looks kinda strange if you ask me.
1520002.d1: Will I really find others like myself here?
1520002.n0: Is this the Grandis? It looks peculiar.
1520002.n1: Will I really find others like myself here?

1520003.name: Tess
1520003.d0: Explorers ought to help each other.
1520003.d1: Doesn't matter what you say, you still look like Kao.
1520003.n0: Explorers ought to help each other.
1520003.n1: Hey, Kao! Huh? Aren't you Kao?

1520005.name: Olive
1520005.d0: I'll be waitin' right here. Bring me back good news.
1520005.d1: Oh, shiny jewels. Wherever ya go, I'll follow.
1520005.n0: I'll be waitin' right here. Bring me back good news.
1520005.n1: Oh, shiny jewels. Wherever ya go, I'll follow.

1520008.name: Olive
1520008.d0: I'm goin' to catch whoever framed me and make 'em pay.
1520008.d1: I'm only in hiding because I was framed! I'm innocent!
1520008.n0: I'm goin' to catch whoever framed me and make 'em pay.
1520008.n1: I'm only in hiding because I was framed! I'm innocent!

1520009.name: Olive
1520009.d0: Neinheart, the Cygnus Knight tactician, has got to know somethin' that'll help my case!
1520009.d1: Ya know, he's kinda cute, but he makes me uneasy...
1520009.n0: Will ya talk to Neinheart on my behalf?
1520009.n1: I need ya to clear my name! Please! I'm innocent!

1520010.name: Rondo
1520010.d0: I'm on a very important thief-catching mission.
1520010.d1: Do not interfere with my mission.
1520010.n0: I'm on a very important thief-catching mission.
1520010.n1: Do not interfere with my mission.

dialogue.32279: How c-could you?! I thought you were going to keep my secret a secret!

1520012.name: Tess
1520012.d0: Athena Pierce hasn't changed much. Then again, she IS an Elf.
1520012.d1: Wait, if I calculate the average age of everyone here...
1520012.n0: Let's sniff out what the Black Wings are up to, Kao.
1520012.n1: Oh, right. I forgot. You're 'not' Kao.

dialogue.32283: 'Mr. Black Wing'? You talking to me?
dialogue.32284: Information isn't valuable unless you have to hunt a few hundred monsters to earn it. Right?

1520015.name: Sugar
1520015.d0: I'm so h-happy to see you again!
1520015.d1: What do you think the Black Wings are up to in here?
1520015.n0: I'm so h-happy to see you again!
1520015.n1: What do you think the Black Wings are up to in here?

1520016.name: Tess
1520016.d0: Stop talking to me. It's getting annoying.
1520016.d1: The Master of Disguise, or whoever he is, is a member of the Black Wings...
1520016.n0: Stop talking to me. It's getting annoying.
1520016.n1: The Master of Disguise, or whoever he is, is a member of the Black Wings...

1520017.name: Olive
1520017.d0: I'm NEVER goin' to forgive the Master of Disguise!
1520017.d1: Because of him, I've been on the run!
1520017.n0: I'm NEVER goin' to forgive the Master of Disguise!
1520017.n1: Because of him, I've been on the run!

1520018.name: Rondo
1520018.d0: I still have unanswered questions. Gonna keep an eye on them for a while.
1520018.d1: Why am I wearing a different hat? Because I don't want to smell like dirty, greasy hair. DUH.
1520018.n0: I'm going to keep an eye on them for a while.

1520027.name: Athena Pierce
1520027.d0: The Black Mage is just on the other side of this gate...
1520027.d1: The Black Mage must have a reason for revealing himself now of all times...
1520027.n0: The Black Mage is just on the other side of this gate...
1520027.n1: I pray this is not the beginning of a disaster.

1520030.name: Someone Boring
1520030.d1: Is this an event? Should I search for a quest giver?

1520031.name: Bippity Bob
1520031.n1: I've been just messing around on the boat because I don't know what else to do.

1520032.name: Dark Magician
1520032.d0: We don't have time for this. We must save Maple World!
1520032.d1: Ugh, if only I had stronger equipment...
1520032.n0: We don't have time for this. Come on. We must save Maple World!
1520032.n1: Ugh, if only I had stronger equipment...

1520033.name: Lucky Gal
1520033.d1: Maybe I'll just eat something first.
1520033.n1: Gosh, why is she taking so long?

1520034.name: Sugar
1520034.d0: I can't believe what's happened to Maple Island.
1520034.d1: I'm glad the fire didn't burn up the Maple Tree.
1520034.n0: I can't believe what's happened to Maple Island.

1520035.name: Tess
1520035.d0: Whatever the Black Mage is scheming, this isn't the end of it.
1520035.n0: This isn't a real attack. It's just a warning.
1520035.n1: We have to gather as much information as we can.

dialogue.32319: We need more information. We have to find the Heroes.

1520036.name: Olive
1520036.n1: The cowards are goin' to pay.

1520037.name: Rondo
1520037.d1: There must be something we can do.
1520037.n1: There must be something we can do.

1520039.name: Lilin
1520039.n0: Did you come to see Aran?
1520039.n1: How much do you know about him?
1520039.d0: Aran will be back soon... ish.
1520039.d1: I wonder how Aran's doing with his training.

dialogue.32323: Okay, I admit you know a thing or two about Aran.

1520040.name: Aran
1520040.d1: I really wish I could remember more. Sorry.
1520040.n0: So the Black Mage is back, huh?

dialogue.32325: I'm sorry that I can't be more helpful.

1520041.name: Evan
1520041.d0: They call me a Hero, but I wasn't around when they sealed the Black Mage away centuries ago.
1520041.d1: My name is Evan. This is Mir, my dragon.
1520041.n0: Mir's great! Except when she's not. Don't tell her I said that!
1520041.n1: My name is Evan. This is Mir, my dragon.

dialogue.32329: There are so many errands to run on a farm!

1520042.name: Mir

2012005.n1: I also have various tasty dishes made by us fairies.

2012005.c1: I'm sure the fairies in Ellinia are doing well... Right?

2012006.name: Isa the Station Guide
2012006.n0: Orbis Station is huge. Talk to me if you want to go to the station platform.
2012006.n1: The platform you want depends on your destination. Ask me to guide you to the right platform!

2012007.name: Rinz the Assistant
2012007.n0: Hello! Thanks for visiting our hair salon!
2012007.n1: I may not be as good as the owner, but... How about letting me take care of your hair?
2012007.s0: Do you want to know about the latest trends in hair? I'll take care of you!
2012007.s1: Fairies love beautiful things, so I'm thinking it may help you on your journey down the road to have beautiful-looking hair.
2012007.c0: Wow! The owner is still the best of the best at this!
2012007.c1: Please don't just leave... Check out the hairstyles available for a change...
2012007.d0: Hello! Thank you for choosing our Hair Salon!
2012007.d1: Yay! The Scissorhands you gave me really help!

2012008.name: Romi
2012008.n1: So you want the latest, most  popular skin color, right?
2012008.s0: What skins are popular in Victoria Island?
2012008.s1: Nicely-tanned skin gives you a healthy look.

2012009.name: Riza the Assistant
2012009.n0: You look like someone that may need plastic surgery.
2012009.n1: How about completely redoing your face? You could try on the latest popular look.

2012010.name: Elma the Housekeeper

2012010.d1: It looks like you've been looking for her too. Do you have any idea how this all happened? I wonder where she is.

2012011.name: Kriel the Fairy
2012011.n0: Humans really are shameless. They expect miracles to rain from the heavens!
2012011.n1: We don't have enough workers, but I'm still strong enough to pull my weight.

2012011.d1: Spiruna young friend... is she doing well? Tell her I said hello!

2012012.name: Lisa
2012012.n1: I'm worried that monsters these days are much more ferocious...
2012012.d1: Lately I've been concerned about this group of aggressive monsters...

2012013.name: Sunny

2012013.n2: The ship is about to leave. Please wait one moment.

2012016.name: Aileen
2012016.n1: We sincerely hope you enjoy your trip!
2012016.n0: Please purchase a ticket from me to get on board.

2012017.name: Hughes the Fuse
2012017.d0: I need to invent something else. This is going to be good...
2012017.s1: I can make anything... I'm a genius! HAHA!

2012018.name: Ericsson
2012018.d0: Look at my kitty! Isn't she cute?
2012018.d1: Look at my kitty! Isn't she cute?

2012020.name: Alfonse Green

2012020.s1: There are many delicious foods around the world! I love eating!
2012020.d1: I just drank Nependeath juice! It is so good.

2012021.name: Ramini

2012022.name: Pelace
2012022.n1: I recommend heading to Minar Forest near Leafre.
2012022.n0: Leafre? It's a town! There's a beautiful forest there...

2012023.d1: The red maple leaf within the clear marble is dormant. It awaits the hero of Maple World...

2012024.name: Egnet
2012024.n0: The genie is about to leave. Please stand behind the safety line.
2012024.n1: During our voyage, don't shout or run around.

2012025.name: Geras
2012025.n0: Please line up in a single line.

2012026.name: Elliza

2012034.d1: (A brick that blends into the background. It bulges out just slightly. It looks as if it can be dislodged.)

2012036.name: Plastic Roy

2012040.name: Daedal
2012040.s0: If we all work together, we can overcome any difficulty.

2012041.name: Daedal
2012041.s0: Would you like to challenge Arcanus, the demon of Sharenian?
2012041.s1: Do you have the courage and the wits to explore dangerous places?

2013000.name: Wonky the Fairy
2013000.s1: I'm hungry hungry hungry! Anything to eat?
2013000.d0: Hee hee! Do you have any more delicious stuff?

2013002.name: Minerva the Goddess
2013002.d0: I am Minerva, the Goddess of wisdom and beauty.
2013002.d1: May your future hold nothing but greatness!
2013002.s0: I am Minerva, the Goddess of wisdom and beauty.
2013002.s1: May your future hold nothing but greatness!

2020000.name: Vogen
2020000.n0: If you have any raw ore or jewels, you can leave the rest to me...

2020000.d0: El Nath mine was once bustling...
2020000.d1: Those were good times. But even now, it's not so bad.

2020001.name: Scott
2020001.n0: You won't find these weapons anywhere else. Haha!
2020001.n1: Our weapon store only deals in the finest weapons around.

2020002.name: Gordon

2020002.d0: What can I do for you?
2020002.d1: How is your gear holding up?

2020003.name: Master Sergeant Fox
2020003.n0: Argh... WHERE DID MY MEN GO?!
2020003.n1: I need to find them fast. Hey you! Can you help me out here?
2020003.d0: All my men were separated and spread out in an accident. I hope they're all right.
2020003.d1: Oh... Thanks for locating all my men for me the other day. Have you run into any of them since? If not, then you should go see them. They may ask you for some help.

2020004.name: Mr. Thalj
2020004.n0: You need a place to store your items and mesos? Then you came to the right place.
2020004.n1: My storage is safe and secure, so you can sleep easy at night.

2020005.name: Alcaster
2020005.n0: Hmm, fascinating. Even after all this time, there is so much to discover...

2020005.d0: I'm Alcaster the sorcerer, and I've been working on various spells and magic here for over 300 years.
2020005.d1: Thanks to you, I can live the rest of my days in peace, researching as I always have. All I ask now is that you keep yourself out of trouble.

2020006.name: Jade
2020006.n0: An old friend of mine is suddenly nowhere to be found... I wonder how she's doing these days...
2020006.n1: I've been investigating around town lately and found some very interesting facts in the process...
2020006.d0: I've been studying the geography of this island for a long time, and I still don't know a lot of things. I need more data. Anyway, I'm worried about this friend of mine in Orbis who disappeared out of the blue. I wonder what happened to her.
2020006.d1: I have no clue where Hella may be or what she is doing, but I'm sure she's doing just fine there. I'll be fine here, waiting for the day when I see her again.

2020007.name: Scadur
2020007.n0: Hey, back in the day, I could have taken down some yetis if I felt like it...
2020007.n1: Hunting hasn't been easy these days... Those monsters out there got pretty ferocious...
2020007.d0: Monsters have been getting much more ferocious lately. It's gotten to the point where I am worried about getting killed out there. I used to go hunt down a number of yetis a day, but those days are now over. I'm old.
2020007.d1: Monsters have been getting much more ferocious lately. It's gotten to the point where I am worried about getting killed out there. I used to go hunt down a number of yetis a day, but those days are now over. I'm old.

2020008.d0: Only the strongest of the strong deserves to move up the ladder and make the job advancement.
2020008.d1: I can literally feel your strength exude from your body.
2020008.n0: Do you want to be a more powerful warrior than you ever were?

2020009.n0: You'll need to see me in order to become the best magician in the world.

2020010.n0: The path of the bowman is long and treacherous.

2020011.n0: You want to become a powerful thief? Then you've come to the right person.

2020012.name: Spirit of Snow Statue
2020012.d0: (A broken statue. Jagged ice sticks out everywhere, and the remains barely resemble a structure.)
2020012.d1: (A broken statue. It was restored once, but it was broken once more by someone else.)

2020013.n1: Please be quiet. This is a sacred place.

2020013.d1: I can see the darkness inside you.
2020013.n0: If you are a pirate who wants to gain amazing powers, come and see me.

2020014.name: Snowman
2020014.d0: It's not that I don't like living here serving the Snow Spirit... but...
2020014.d1: It's not that I don't like living here serving the Snow Spirit... but...

2020015.name: Jenn's Brother
2020015.n0: Eh heh heh... It feels great to be in town.
2020015.d0: It's dangerous outside of town. Best stay inside, where it's safe.
2020015.d1: It's dangerous outside of town. Best stay inside, where it's safe.

2022000.n1: Without armor, you may run into some trouble against monsters. Take a look around and see if you like any of these.

2022001.name: Hana
2022001.n0: Hello! I'm Hana, the master alchemist in this town. Take a look around and see if you find anything you like.
2022001.n1: Welcome! Whatever you may need for your journey, I have it all.

2022002.name: Barun
2022002.n0: I made these scrolls, so I can guarantee that these all work to perfection!
2022002.n1: Making scrolls is even easier than hunting down slimes.

2022003.name: Shammos
2022003.s1: Not too long until... I escape this dark place...
2022003.d1: Everything is going according to plan...
2022003.g0: I will use the secret door to get to the ravine. Why don't you guys go through Ice Valley?

2022004.name: Tylus

2022004.n1: I'm very much relieved to know that there are people willing to fight these monsters.

2022005.name: Shammos
2022005.s0: Har har... Shammos knows... He will resurrect soon...
2022005.g0: Now, follow me through my secret path.
2022005.d1: Everything is going according to plan...

2022009.name: Shammos
2022009.n0: Let's go seal up Rex again.

2030000.n0: Don't even think about entering here... It's not some place where just anyone can waltz on in...
2030000.n1: Only the strongest can enter here... If you want in, talk to me.

2040015.n2: I'm #p2040015#. There are a lot of dangerous machines around, so please be careful.
2040015.d0: Hello there! I'm #b#p2040015##k, the guy in charge of the Toy Factory. Today's another one of those busy days...
2040015.d1: Oh! You're the one that met up with our Roly-Polies in Eos Tower for me! How can I help you? Huh? Haha, of course, I didn't forget the lunch box my daughter made for me. I'm just waiting for lunch, so I can eat it! I'll see you around!

2040016.name: Pi
2040016.n0: I can make anything I put my mind to!
2040016.n1: Hmmm... You can gather some really fine materials here in Ludibrium.

2040017.name: Green M-Forcer
2040017.n0: As long as we're here, everything will be fine!
2040017.d0: I'm here on a very important assignment for the Omega Sector. It's very dangerous around here, so I suggest you get out of here while you still can.
2040017.d1: The Roswell Field is prone to alien appearances, so this place is under constant watch. The battle is still ongoing, so I suggest you and the others not get too comfortable here. For now, I have to head back to the Sector for some more work. See you around!

2040018.name: Black M-Forcer
2040018.n0: Pink M-Forcer is ALWAYS late... we can't be at 100% strength unless all 5 of us are here.
2040018.n1: Nothing scares us when all 5 of us are together!
2040018.d0: Hello! I'm #b#p2040018##k, and my mission is to prevent the alien invasion here. There's been a lot more activity lately, and it's gotten very dangerous around here. I suggest you run back to the Omega Sector where it's safe.
2040018.d1: Oh! You're the one that helped me get the #b#o4230116##k out of Coolan Field! It's good to find someone like you here where dangerous aliens are so common. I'm still investigating the mastermind behind all this and going up against yet another alien. It's not going to be easy.

2040019.name: Everton
2040019.n0: Welcome to our hospital! Your face looks terrrible. Need my help?
2040019.n1: Every once in a while comes a person whose face is a little hard to touch. You happen to be that person... Haha! How do you want it?

2040020.name: Sarah
2040020.n1: I have a special glove for you... You want to take a look?
2040020.n0: It is easy to make gloves!

2040021.name: Tara
2040021.n0: My shoes are highly sought-after these days.
2040021.n1: Ever heard of an...accelerant? It's a rare item people used in the past... Heheheh...

2040022.name: Rydole
2040022.n1: Crafting a great weapon requires a strong arm and stronger spirit.

2040023.name: Lost Soldier
2040023.d0: Eos Tower is humongous... So big that we get lost in this place every once in a while.
2040023.d1: Hmmm... Where am I? You'd think the head of security for the 59th floor of Eos Tower would know their way around, but I have nooo idea where I am at the moment. Hmmm...

2040028.name: Mark the Toy Soldier
2040028.n0: Please find the dollhouse that looks different from the others.
2040028.n1: If you want to leave this place, talk to me.

2040029.name: Grandpa Clock
2040029.n0: What can I do for you today? It's dangerous around here, so I suggest you go somewhere safer.
2040029.d0: I'm #b#p2040029##k. My mission is to investigate Ludibrium Clocktower, but I can't seem to find any problems here.
2040029.d1: I see you told #b#p2040002##k the Clocktower's fixed. Hopefully the soldiers can rely on it for the time now. Thank you so much! And listen, I've got to get back to work, so you may want to head back to Ludibrium where it's safe.

2040030.name: Wisp
2040030.n1: If you want to revive your pet, then talk to me.

2040032.name: Weaver
2040032.n0: Do you want to train your pet? Then you've come to the right place.
2040032.n1: Raising pets can be a tough task at times.

2040033.name: Neru
2040033.n0: My brother and I majored in pet training.
2040033.n1: The more you train your pet, the closer you two will become.

2040034.name: Red Sign
2040034.n0: You may not go higher than where you are right now.

2040035.name: Arturo
2040035.f0: Your accomplishments will be remembered forever.
2040035.f1: I had no doubt in my mind that you'd succeed.
2040035.f2: It must have been a dangerous... How did you manage to beat it?

2040036.name: Red Balloon
2040036.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040037.name: Orange Balloon
2040037.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040038.name: Yellow Balloon
2040038.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040039.name: Lime Balloon
2040039.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040040.name: Green Balloon
2040040.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040041.name: Aqua Balloon
2040041.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040042.name: Sky-Blue Balloon
2040042.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040043.name: Blue Balloon
2040043.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040044.name: Violet Balloon
2040044.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040045.name: Pink Balloon
2040045.n0: I can help you out on many levels.

2040046.name: Robert Holly
2040046.n0: And now...I have no friends to add and no money to make.
2040046.n1: If your buddy list is full, then come see me.

2040047.name: Sgt. Anderson
2040047.n2: Please don't tell me you're giving up already.
2040047.n0: Please take care of Alishar, the gatekeeper of this world.
2040047.n1: I'll show you to the path that leads to the 101st floor of Eos Tower.

2040048.name: Nara
2040048.n0: How about taking a ride to the most exotic island in MapleStory, Florina Beach?
2040048.n1: Do you have a power ticket by any chance? You should get on the ride and enjoy the fun.
2040048.d0: Don't you want to head off to Florina Beach?
2040048.d1: You look exhausted. How about spending some time relaxing at Florina Beach?

2040050.name: Eurek the Alchemist
2040050.s0: With a few materials, you can make summoning rocks and magic rocks.
2040050.d0: Hello there. I'm Eurek the Alchemist. I'm wandering throughout the world of MapleStory. I'm just stopping here for a bit.

2040051.name: Toly
2040051.s0: This is the best medicine ever made!
2040051.s1: You can take something to recover or something to boost your speed, so you can avoid getting hurt.
2040051.a1: Check this place out. Isn't it cool?
2040051.s3: I made these myself, but there aren't many left. You should buy them now before it's too late.

2040052.name: Wiz the Librarian
2040052.n0: This library has more than just old-fashioned books. There are several fun fairy tales... Well, there used to be.
2040052.n1: I'd love to find the lost books soon.
2040052.d0: All the books are mixed up.
2040052.d1: This library is finally beginning to resemble a normal library.

2041000.name: Tian
2041000.n2: For those who'd like to board the boat to Orbis Station, right this way please!
2041000.n0: If you want board the ship to Orbis, please hand me your ticket.
2041000.n1: We've got limited space, so please board soon! We're about to take off!

2041001.name: Rosey
2041001.n2: Please be aware that if you enter the Cash Shop while on board, you'll be sent back to where you started.
2041001.n0: Can I help you with anything? Enjoy your trip!
2041001.n1: Anyone that wants to leave the ship and return to the starting point, please come talk to me.

2041002.name: Hid
2041002.n0: There are places in Ludibrium where the monsters pop out of nowhere.
2041002.n1: We have a weapon JUST FOR YOU!

2041003.name: Miru
2041003.n0: Welcome! Take a look around and see what you like.
2041003.n1: Tough armor is a necessity. Monsters could pop up anywhere in the castle!

2041004.name: Marcel
2041004.n0: Make sure you don't get lost inside the castle.
2041004.d0: Hello there! I'm #b#p2041004##k, head of Ludibrium security. Lately there have been some filthy creatures dirtying up Eos Tower, and I don't like it one bit.
2041004.d1: Hey! You're the one that cleaned out Eos Tower for me! How have you been? I'm thrilled the number of monsters has decreased, and they aren't as wild as they were before. I really appreciate all your hard work. I hope you have a great day in Ludibrium!

2041005.name: Nemi
2041005.n1: Isn't it beautiful today? I would like nothing more than to just go somewhere...
2041005.d0: Oh, hi! I don't think I've met you before... Have you been traveling around? I'm #b#p2041005##k, a resident here in Ludibrium. My father is the manager of the Toy Factory. If you have time, you should go see that place.
2041005.d1: Hello! Thanks to you, my dad got his appetite back! How can I help you today? Oh no! Don't come in here with your shoes on! I just cleaned! Please come back some other time!

2041006.name: Misky
2041006.n0: We sell stuff that you can't find anywhere else!
2041006.n1: Need potions or some food? You've come to the right place.
2041006.a0: You! You're not trying to swipe something, are you?
2041006.a1: Touch anything, and I'll be very, very angry with you!
2041006.g0: Making new potions is tougher than you think.
2041006.g1: Hah! Just making new potions here...

2041007.name: Miyu
2041007.n1: If you want to try a different hair style, then just talk to me!
2041007.n0: Oh my, you still have that hairdo? That's sooo yesterday...

2041008.name: Seppy
2041008.n0: Looking for a place to store your mesos or items? Then look no further!
2041008.n1: Our storage is safe as can be, so feel free to leave your stuff here!

2041009.name: Mini
2041009.n1: It's a tough act being a hair stylist...
2041009.n0: Welcome to our Hair Salon! I'm still learning, but would you let me do your hair?
2041009.d0: Welcome to our Hair Salon! I'm still learning, but would you let me do your hair?
2041009.d1: Strong explorers are awesome! But good-looking once are even better!

2041010.name: Ellie
2041010.n0: Wanna change your face into something... Much more beautiful?
2041010.n1: You look fine now, but with a little touch here and there, you'll look FANTABULOUS!

2041011.name: Yellow M-Forcer
2041011.n0: Worried about monsters? Let us handle them!
2041011.n1: It's our job to protect everyone here!
2041011.d0: Hi. I'm #b#p2041011##k, and I'm leading a special mission here. Have you seen any aliens? They like to trick innocent strangers by sweet-talking them, so be on your guard.
2041011.d1: Hi. I'm #b#p2041011##k, and I'm leading a special mission here. Have you seen any aliens? They like to trick innocent strangers by sweet-talking them, so be on your guard.

2041012.name: Pink M-Forcer
2041012.n0: It's so hard to wake up early each morning. I should stop being late...
2041012.n1: I'm more than happy to protect you all, except that I sleep waaay too much...
2041012.d0: Hello,there. I'm #b#p2041012##k on secret assignment from the Omega Sector to stop the alien invasion. All of my important missions have been keeping me very busy! Oh, an this place is really dangerous. I suggest you find somewhere safer to be.
2041012.d1: You're back! I've been so much more punctual lately. Even the big wigs upstairs are noticing. And it's all thanks to you! Now, I have something important to do, so please excuse me!

2041013.name: Gina
2041013.n0: You want to have a slim body like me? I will make your skin beautiful!
2041013.n1: Wow... You must be traveling all around. Your skin's really damaged.

2041014.name: Patricia
2041014.n0: Are you looking for pet food?
2041014.n1: Aren't your pets hungry? I got some food for them!

2041015.name: Korin
2041015.f0: I feel like I've witnessed something incredible.
2041015.f1: ...I don't remember...the last few months...that I've been...missing...
2041015.f2: I've been trying to remember things, but it's hard.
2041015.f3: Did something terrible happen to me?
2041015.w0: Whenever I think about that day... I just feel terrified and burst into tears.
2041015.w1: Please... Someone help me regain my lost memory.
2041015.d0: Hmmm...? I don't think we've ever met. What are you doing in my house? If you don't have anything to talk about, then please leave.
2041015.d1: You're the one that helped me find my lost memories. I can't thank you enough for your effort. I've been trying to live a normal life these days.

2041016.name: Vega
2041016.n0: I admit, I fail at making scrolls occasionally, but it's very rare!
2041016.n1: I've made my share of mistakes making these scrolls, but don't worry. I'm good at this!

2041017.name: Ace of Hearts
2041017.n0: Sweet chocolate can go a long way toward telling your beloved 'I LOVE YOU!'
2041017.n1: I, the Ace of Hearts, will let you in on the sweet, chocolatey secret recipe of love!
2041017.d0: I'm here to bake lovely treats! Doesn't it smell scrumptious here? Mmm hmmm!
2041017.d1: I can only make so much of it by myself. Bear with me. I can only make you one per hour.

2041018.name: Hans the Assembler
2041018.f0: I am the best at assembling toys here at the Toy Factory.
2041018.f1: Gather the materials I need, and I'll make something nice for you in return!
2041018.d0: I just need a few things to make a fun toy to play with, but I don't know if I'm even allowed to make this.
2041018.d1: Hey,what's going on? Have you tried using the stuff I gave you? That item had some experimental elements to it, so it's a little dangerous, but it was fun to make something I've always dreamed of. Well, I have to get back to work now. See ya!

2041019.name: Rocky the Repairman
2041019.n0: Why does this keep breaking down?
2041019.d0: It's broken again... And I just fixed this not too long ago! Who did this?! If only I could get my hands on whoever's responsible for this... ARRGH!
2041019.d1: Oh no! It must be the monsters again. As soon as I fix this, they come rushing back to break it again. Thanks to the parts you got me, I've at least been able to fix things here and there, but my work's never done. Anyway, I gotta go!

2041020.name: Mac the Mechanic
2041020.d0: Great weather today! I'm #b#p2041020##k, and I work here at the Toy Factory. I'm in charge of making blueprints for the machines around here and fixing them if necessary.
2041020.d1: You're back! I've been working like a fiend thanks to the documents you got me. Oh, and this time, I hid them in a safe just in case. So thanks! I have to get back to work now. See you around!

2041021.name: Mr. Bouffon
2041021.n0: We need to find the source of power for the time sphere at the center of Ludibrium.
2041021.n1: We need an energy replacement for the time sphere. Please gather up Tachions.
2041021.s0: We have to seal the Dimensional Schism.
2041021.s1: If you break the time sphere, you'll come face to face with the source of all evil!
2041021.d0: I'm Mr. Bouffon, guardian of the Path of Time.
2041021.d1: Thanks to you the root of all evil in Ludibrium is gone forever! Only peaceful days lay ahead.

2041022.name: Tigun the Advisor
2041022.s0: Are you here to deliver the history book? Let's see...
2041022.d0: I, Tigun the Advisor, am responsible for helping the King of Ludibrium run this place as smoothly as possible. Hmmm...
2041022.d1: Aren't you the honorable traveler? Did you meet with #t1012109#? You remind me of my own traveling days... I was one fearless kid back then...

2041023.name: Flo
2041023.d0: I'm Flo, in charge of protecting the Path of Time. Would you like to see me work my magic?
2041023.d1: Showtime! Am I good or what?

2041026.name: Ghosthunter Bob
2041026.s0: When was the last time I had a decent meal? Urgh...
2041026.t0: Hey! Who do you think you are, roaming around this place like you own it?
2041026.d1: I feel a negative vibe around here...

2041027.name: Mason the Collector
2041027.m0: Look, but don't touch! These items are precious!
2041027.m1: I need to collect, collect, and collect...
2041027.d0: I want this, this, this, and that...

2041028.name: Unknown Thief
2041028.n0: If you want something, you'll need to pay for it.
2041028.n1: Do you want something from me?
2041028.d0: I can't believe I'm here doing chores like this. I understand it's an order, but that doesn't make it any easier.
2041028.d1: It's surprising Hellin would look out for someone like you. Of course, I'm sure it's not all that fun to be under a microscope. He's quite ruthless, to say the least.

2041029.name: Karen
2041029.n0: This is the time control room for Ludibrium. Only authorized personnel may enter.
2041029.n1: I can't believe the time controller is broken...
2041029.d0: Oh no! The time controller's broken down!
2041029.d1: Ahhh... I can't believe you just skipped time like that. The goddess will not forgive you for it.

2041030.name: Mick
2041030.d0: We should wait patiently for the Black Mage to resurrect.
2041030.d1: As the servant of the Black Mage, I can help you all!

2041031.name: Death Teddy
2041031.d0: Oh no! Someone destroyed the security device for the time controller!
2041031.d1: Freely traveling time and space... The goddess will never forgive you.

2041032.name: Ducky
2041032.n0: One, two, three, four... Wait a minute! That one's not mine!
2041032.d0: All of my kids make me happy... But I never have a second to myself. I'm always busy counting my babies.
2041032.d1: All of my kids make me happy... But I never have a second to myself. I'm always busy counting my babies.

2041033.name: Ducky Five
2041033.d0: Running is more fun than walking! I want to run! Faster!
2041033.d1: No more running. Now I want to fly! What can I do to fly?

2042000.name: Spiegelmann
2042000.n0: If you wanna see something special, come on down to the Monster Carnival!
2042000.n1: Aren't you curious to see who the strongest adventurer is amongst your friends?

2042001.name: Spiegelmann
2042001.n0: If you wanna see something special, come on down to the Monster Carnival!
2042001.n1: Aren't you curious to see who the strongest adventurer is amongst your friends?

2042002.name: Spiegelmann
2042002.n0: If you wanna see something special, come on down to the Monster Carnival!
2042002.n1: Aren't you curious to see who the strongest adventurer is amongst your friends?

2042003.name: Assistant Red
2042003.n0: All of you will exit this place as soon as you talk to me.

2042004.name: Assistant Blue
2042004.n0: All of you will exit this place as soon as you talk to me.

2042005.name: Spiegelmann
2042005.n1: Aren't you curious to see who the strongest adventurer is amongst your friends?
2042005.n0: If you wanna see something special, come on down to the Monster Carnival!

2042006.name: Spiegelmann
2042006.n1: Aren't you curious to see who the strongest adventurer is amongst your friends?
2042006.n0: If you wanna see something special, come on down to the Monster Carnival!

2042007.name: Spiegelmann
2042007.n1: Aren't you curious to see who the strongest adventurer is amongst your friends?
2042007.n0: If you wanna see something special, come on down to the Monster Carnival!

2042008.name: Assistant Red
2042008.n0: All of you will exit this place as soon as you talk to me.

2042009.name: Assistant Blue
2042009.n0: All of you will exit this place as soon as you talk to me.

2042010.name: Spiegelmann
2042010.n0: If you wanna see something special, come on down to the Monster Carnival!
2042010.n1: Show your friends who's the toughest at the Monster Carnival!

2043000.name: Papulatus
2043000.n0: The crack in our dimension... When will the experiment end?
2043000.n1: If only I can warp time...

2050000.name: Dr. San
2050000.n0: I have lots of weapons for you. Pick one!
2050000.n1: It is so hard to find material for weapons in these days. There are just too many monsters.

2050001.name: Dr. Kim
2050001.n0: We need to get going soon, but where is everyone?
2050001.n1: Hmm... You guys are not strong enough to fight against aliens yet...
2050001.d0: Oh... It's the greatest masterpiece of all time, created by me! With this blueprint, I can make the most indestructible robot ever!
2050001.d1: Hmmm... The fuel's fine, the parts are fine... And by debugging this critical error in the Alpha system... Huh? Can I help you? I'm busy developing new machines, so unless you need me for something, talk to someone else. I need to get back to work.

2050002.name: Alien Gray
2050002.n1: I want to be your friend.
2050002.d0: The Omega Sector is busy attacking innocent aliens again... How unfortunate...
2050002.d1: Hahaha! You fool! We're already deciphering the critical document you gave me. Before, the Omega Sector's security has been ironclad, but it's only a matter of time now. And I don't need you anymore, so get lost!

2050003.name: Spacen
2050003.n0: We have lots of excellent armor in Omega Sector.
2050003.n1: You must have good armor to fight against the aliens.

2050004.name: Kubo the Storageman
2050004.n0: Are you looking for a storage place?
2050004.n1: My storage is totally safe! I guarantee it...

2050005.name: Chury
2050005.n0: Tsk, tsk... I'll be late if I don't get going!
2050005.n1: As long as I'm here, this place is safe!
2050005.d0: This is my first break in a long time. I've been up the past few days on missions. The aliens always act up after dark... Anyway, I need to enjoy this as much as I can. Then again, I should still be on guard...
2050005.d1: You're the one that brought #b#p2050001#'s#k #b#t4031100##k here and showed it to me. I can't thank you enough for that. How's the robot coming along? I can't wait for the day I get my hands on it. Now, I need to finish my training, so please excuse me.

2050006.name: Hoony
2050006.n1: I'm getting tired of going on missions every day.
2050006.d0: I'm #b#p2050006##k here on a secret mission from the Omega Sector. Now don't take this personally. You seem like a trustworthy person, but I can't divulge any sensitive mission intel.
2050006.d1: You're the one that brought #b#p2050001#'s#k #b#t4031100##k here and showed it to me. I can't thank you enough for that. How's the robot coming along? I can't wait for the day I get to have my hands on that robot. Now I need to get back to work...

2050007.name: Gunny
2050007.d0: I'm #b#p2050007##k here on a secret mission from the Omega Sector. Now don't take this personally. You seem like a trustworthy person, but I can't divulge any sensitive mission intel.
2050007.d1: You're the one that brought #b#p2050001#'s#k #b#t4031100##k here and showed it to me. I can't thank you enough for that. How's the robot coming along? I can't wait for the day I get to have my hands on that robot. Now I need to get back to work...

2050008.name: General Maestro
2050008.n0: My army is here to protect this place today, tomorrow, as long as they need us.
2050008.n1: I don't have time for idle chit chat. I'm in the middle of an important operation.
2050008.d0: Thanks for coming to the Omega Sector. Now stay alert! The aliens could attack at any moment. And while you're here, there's someone who could use your help. If you're interested, go talk to them.
2050008.d1: The weather is just perfect outside! This place is so secure and protected from aliens that it's been eerily quiet the last few days. But I can't complain. I'm so grateful for all the help you gave me!

2050009.name: Jr. Officer Medin
2050009.n0: I'm in charge of protecting the general as well as directing the army.
2050009.n1: I am not going to tolerate anyone slacking off!
2050009.d0: A-ten-hut! Can you help me perhaps?
2050009.d1: Good job. I will work harder to assist General Maestro.

2050010.name: Rice the Medic
2050010.n0: I've studied a lot, but I don't have real working experience yet.
2050010.n1: Red medicine should take care of most injuries.
2050010.d0: I'm #b#p2050010##k, and as you can see, I care for the wounded here in the Omega Sector. You should take a page from my book and keep a wary eye. You never know when aliens will attack!
2050010.d1: I'm #b#p2050010##k, and as you can see, I care for the wounded here in the Omega Sector. You should take a page from my book and keep a wary eye. You never know when aliens will attack!

2050011.name: Kevin the Soldier
2050011.n0: I heard there are aliens everywhere outside... I wish I could go fight them too.
2050011.n1: Jr. Officer Medin is famous for being so strict.
2050011.d0: *Sigh.* I wish I could go outside and take on the aliens myself, but I'm stuck doing work at HQ. I know I could kick some serious space-butt too. When will I get to help defend the planet...?
2050011.d1: *Sigh.* I wish I could go outside and take on the aliens myself, but I'm stuck doing work at HQ. I know I could kick some serious space-butt too. When will I get to help defend the planet...?

2050012.name: Agent M
2050012.n0: Hey... Have you ever seen an alien?
2050012.n1: Please don't tell anyone that you met me.
2050012.d0: Shh! It's better if you pretend like you don't know me. I'm in the middle of a very important mission. If you don't have anything important to discuss, just leave.
2050012.d1: Hmm... #b#p2041015##k seems to have retrieved her lost memories. Warn her to be more careful, so she doesn't get abducted by aliens again, and it there's nothing else, you can move on.

2050013.name: Porter
2050013.n0: I'm Porter, a researcher here in the Omega Sector.
2050013.n1: I have so much to research, I don't even have time to sleep.
2050013.d0: Hello there! My name is #b#p2050013##k, and I'm helping #b#p2050001##k develop a new robot here at headquarters. Sniffle... The new robot's coming along nicely, but I've been feeling a bit under the weather for a while now. Sniff... If you'll excuse me, I have to get back to work. Can't get caught slacking...
2050013.d1: Hello there! My name is #b#p2050013##k, and I'm helping #b#p2050001##k develop a new robot here at headquarters. Sniffle... The new robot's coming along nicely, but I've been feeling a bit under the weather for a while now. Sniff... If you'll excuse me, I have to get back to work. Can't get caught slacking...

2050021.name: Jaime
2050021.d0: Hello there! How goes your training?

2051000.name: Dr. Pepper
2051000.n0: I hope these potions can help you out here.
2051000.n1: My potions are excellent! Completely different from other potions!

2051001.name: Kay
2051001.n0: The Omega Sector contains many important mechanical parts.
2051001.n1: My job is to maintain these machines.

9250005.name: Pond
9250005.n0: The Floating Market is full of energy! I love it!
9250005.n1: Hey, I don't think we've ever met...
9250005.d1: By the way, are you aware that the Floating Market offers numerous types of delicious food? It's so good that you'll want to bring your family and your relatives here to share the love!
9250005.d0: Why do you come to see me?

9250006.name: Nid
9250006.n0: Are you... from a foreign country?
9250006.d0: Hello! I'm Nid. (Blushing) I... I am ... I'm shy...
9250006.d1: Hello! I'm Nid. (Blushing) I... I am ... I'm shy...

9250007.name: Dang
9250007.n0: Our town offers weapons you have NEVER seen from anywhere else!

9250008.name: Parn
9250008.n0: We at the Floating Market pride ourselves in using the finest materials to create medicines of excellent quality. I'm pretty sure you have never heard of some of them.

9250009.name: Noi-nha
9250009.n0: You must be a traveler. I don't think I've ever seen you around here.
9250009.n1: It's really dangerous once you step out of this town. Please prepare yourself with armors you can count on.

9250010.name: Pornsak
9250010.n0: We won't wait for you if you're late.
9250010.n1: It's so hot today. A day like this should be spent under the palm trees enjoying the summer breeze.
9250010.d0: What do you want with me?

9250011.name: Chut
9250011.n0: It's much cooler to stand underneath the palm tree!
9250011.n1: I would love to have some watermelon shake!
9250011.d1: Thank you sooo much for your help last time.

9250012.name: Chai
9250012.n0: On a hot day like this, swimming is the best! Don't believe me? Then go dive in the water!
9250012.n1: You'll be mighty shocked if you find out who I am.
9250012.d1: I should always think about the safety of Floating Market.

9250013.name: Lung Tup
9250013.n0: Look, I'm going to sleep now, so don't talk to me... Okay?
9250013.d0: It's hot outside, and I feel like dozing off. Zzzz...
9250013.d1: I feel like sleeping, so if you don't need anything, leave me alone.

9250014.name: Pooyai Lee
9250014.n0: I'm the chief of this town. Please tell me anything that concerns you.
9250014.n1: My wife is the best at sewing. World-class, I should say.
9250014.d0: How can I help you here?
9250014.d1: Talk to me if you have something to say.

9250016.name: Toon
9250016.n0: I better fix the roof fast; we're in trouble if the rain falls through these cracks.
9250016.n1: (Clank clank) I need to fix this roof ASAP.
9250016.d0: It may be hot in here, and it may be one tough job, \nbut I, #bToon#k, shall never give up!
9250016.d1: Are you here to help me fix the roof?

9250022.name: Yai Bua
9250022.n1: Don't you want to find out about your future?

9250027.name: Kob
9250027.n0: Argh... this is tough! When do we get to finish fixing up the roof?
9250027.n1: I'm going to be really busy until we get this roof fixed.
9250027.d0: Good thing you came. I have something to ask you.
9250027.d1: I need to fix this roof right now. Please leave me alone if you don't have anything to say to me.

9250028.name: Lung Thid
9250028.n0: Ahhh,it's hot today! I need to take a break right now.
9250028.n1: A glass of ice water would be perfect right about now.
9250028.d0: Oh! Good thing you're around. I need your help.
9250028.d1: I'll never forget the time you helped me out when I really needed it.

9250029.name: Thawee
9250029.n0: Look, I'm busy, so don't talk to me. I've got a lot to deal with here.
9250029.d0: What's going on? I'm a busy man!
9250029.d1: I'm busy, so unless it's an urgent matter, please leave me alone.

9300010.name: Mr. Moneybags
9300010.n1: I wonder who can bring me some red envelopes...

9300011.name: Cai Shen
9300011.n0: Come test your luck with Gachapon!
9300011.n1: Who knows? You may get a nice item!
9300011.d1: I can only make these Dumplings and Long Thread Moss Soups at random every 12 hours. So if you want more, come back to me 12 hours after receiving these dishes.

9300012.name: Guan Zhong
9300012.n0: I'm Guan Zhong, the Prime Minister of Qi. Have you heard of 'The Friendship of Guan and Bao?' That's my story. Haha.
9300012.n1: You wish to unlock the seal? I'm the one you should look for!
9300012.n2: You wish to have the key to unlock the seal? I can help you!
9300012.d1: Sharing... A word that warms my heart. I hope you understand what I mean...

9300013.name: Sima Qian
9300013.n0: Have you seen my history book? I'm Sima Qian, the historian.
9300013.n1: Please take good care of your account!
9300013.d1: I can only make these steamed fish and roasted chickens at random every 12 hours. So if you want more, come back to me 12 hours after receiving these dishes.

9300014.name: Zhang Liang
9300014.n0: I'm Zhang Liang. I'm also known as Zhang Zi Fang.
9300014.n1: Take extra care to prevent your account from being stolen!
9300014.n2: You can't drop, trade, or sell sealed items.
9300014.d1: It's all about friendship. Look around you! Sharing with your friends makes the world a better place!

9310000.name: Hong the Pilot
9310000.n0: Sky... the road of my life...

9310001.name: Lady Li
9310001.n0: If you don't have enough money to buy weapons here, then go away!
9310001.n1: This is cheap to begin with. Don't  you ever try bargaining with me!

9310002.name: Owner Jang
9310002.n0: Heheh. I better sell these fast so I can go drink...  Heheh.
9310002.n1: Heheh.  I've been selling armor here for 10 years now.

9310003.name: Lady Jin
9310003.n0: Welcome, welcome! Are you looking for something?
9310003.n1: I can't hook you up with discounts. I only work here part-time.

9310004.name: Officer Lim
9310004.n0: Sir, sir! You cannot throw trash away like that, or I'll have to fine you!
9310004.n1: The laws are there to be followed.
9310004.d1: Is there anything I can help you with?

9310005.name: Officer Chung
9310005.n0: It's off-limits beyond this point. Please turn around.
9310005.n1: I'm on duty. Please don't try me.
9310005.d0: (Salute) I'll have to stop you here. I'm Officer Chung, head of security.
9310005.d1: Please leave. If you do not cooperate, I'll have to use force.

9310006.name: Officer Huh
9310006.n0: If you need any help, feel free to contact us!
9310006.n1: We are here to serve you!

9310007.name: Officer Kang
9310007.n0: Don't mistake me for a celebrity! I'm a police officer!
9310007.n1: Ah, the popularity. I'm sick of it! Ladies! No false reports just to see me!
9310007.d1: Is there anything I can help you with?

9310008.name: Chief Officer Chu
9310008.n0: I'm the chief officer of Shanghai!
9310008.n1: Do you have any questions about us police officers?
9310008.d0: Hello there! I'm Chief Officer Chu, head of security in Shanghai.
9310008.d1: I'm in charge of protecting the city of Shanghai.

9310009.name: Ms. Jo
9310009.n0: It's awwwfully tiring working at the farm when it's this hot!
9310009.n1: I understand I have a strooong acceeent.
9310009.d1: Farming is difficult, but it sure is rewarding!

9310010.name: Mr. Yang
9310010.n1: Farming is very very difficult. Don't ever think this is a walk in the park!
9310010.d0: Ouch, my back! Farming really takes a toll on my body.
9310010.d1: Farming is difficult, but it sure is rewarding!

9310011.name: Owner Yeo
9310011.n0: Hey, my food is REALLY, REALLY good!
9310011.n1: I may be selling these in the streets, but it sure is delicious!
9310011.d0: They call me Master Chef Yeo here in Shanghai!
9310011.d1: Thank you for your help last time. It really helped me a great deal!

9310012.name: Cho the Photographer
9310012.n1: I'll try my best to capture your beauty with this camera.
9310012.d0: Hey there! I'm Cho the Photographer.
9310012.d1: I'm busy taking pictures here and there these days.

9310013.name: Yang the Pilot
9310013.n0: Not everyone's blessed with a job like me - flying around the sky at will!
9310013.n1: It is quite scary looking down at the ground when you're waaay up there.

9330000.name: Rana
9330000.n1: Be sure to check out our large selection of items!

9330001.name: Uncle Wang
9330001.n0: Not too many people have an eye for picking out good weapons.
9330001.n1: A quality weapon will pick out its own master.

9330002.name: Jason Woo
9330002.n0: Hey pretty lady! Come here and try this on. It's perfect for you!
9330002.n1: Yo! Handsome! Try this on. You'll look fabulous in it!

9330003.name: Jay Chewy
9330003.n0: I'm Jay Chewy, the coolest guy in all of Taiwan.
9330003.n1: Hey, girl! You wanna go for a drive?
9330003.d0: Hello! I'm Jay Chewy, the coolest guy in all of Taiwan.
9330003.d1: I wonder how my girlfriend is doing.

9330004.name: Coco Dee
9330004.n0: Hehehe. Taiwan is such a nice place to live.
9330004.n1: Isn't the nightscape of Taiwan just beautiful?
9330004.d1: Thank you for your help last time.

9330005.name: Sammi Fab
9330005.n0: Hi! I'm Sammi Fab, the biggest celebrity in Taiwan.
9330005.n1: I wonder what my schedule is today.
9330005.d0: Hi! I'm Sammi Fab, the biggest celebrity in Taiwan.
9330005.d1: I'm a busy right now. I'm walking my dog.

9330006.name: Aaron Quack
9330006.n0: Hey! Do you have some time?
9330006.n1: You interested in starting a new business?
9330006.d0: I'm the cool and smooth Aaron Quack.
9330006.d1: Thanks a lot for helping me out last time.

9330007.name: Tito
9330007.n0: The subway is still under construction.
9330007.n1: The subway should be opening soon. Thank you for your patience.

9330014.name: Toto
9330014.n0: The subway is still under construction.
9330014.n1: The subway should be opening soon. Thank you for your patience.

9330015.name: The Venerable Mr. Q
9330015.n1: If you're just passing through, go right ahead.

9330016.name: Martin Fan
9330016.n0: Hello! I'm the best chef in Taiwan.
9330016.n1: What should I cook up today?
9330016.d1: Cut up the ingredients, pour some oil in the pan, and fry, fry, fry! Cooking is so much fun!
9330016.d0: Are you here to taste my famous food?

9330017.name: Gumstick Girl
9330017.n0: Mister! You wanna buy some gum?
9330017.n1: Delicious gum for sale! Lots of different flavors! Bubblegum, mint, cinnamon!
9330017.d1: Would you like to buy some gum?

9330018.name: Mr. Ho
9330018.n0: I've been working here for 30 years already.
9330018.n1: I don't seem to have enough materials to sell... Is there anyone that can help me?
9330018.d0: Welcome! I'm Mr. Oh, the street vendor.
9330018.d1: Business just isn't what it used to be.

9330019.name: Judy
9330019.n0: I want to become the best Hair Stylist in Taiwan.
9330019.n1: My boyfriend is... Hehe, that's a secret. Ah, I really miss him.
9330019.d1: Thank you for helping me out the other day.

9330020.name: Christine
9330020.n0: Please take a look at our beautiful accessories.
9330020.n1: We have many items that are very popular in Taiwan.
9330020.d1: I hope my friend is doing okay.

9330021.name: Niki
9330021.n0: Would you like to have the most popular hairstyle in Taiwan?
9330021.n1: Just tell me what type of hairstyle you want.

9330022.name: Julie
9330022.n1: Try changing your hairstyle if you're tired of your old one.

9330023.name: Dr. Nihao
9330023.n0: Would you like to become more beautiful?
9330023.n1: I can give you a beautiful new look!

9330024.name: Nurse Ling Ling
9330024.n1: Want plastic surgery? You've come to the right place!
9330024.n0: I may not be as good as the doctor, but I can still make you beautiful.

9330025.name: Dr. Wink Lee
9330025.n0: If you want a healthy, sun-kissed look, I recommend copper-toned skin.
9330025.n1: Oh, you want to have a clear complexion? Just leave it to me!

9330026.name: Roan Li
9330026.n0: The Night Market is the symbol of Taiwan!
9330026.n1: *Sigh.* I feel so empty. Maybe I need someone special in my life.

9330027.name: Ivanna Mann
9330027.n0: The food at the Night Market is so yummy. It's not helping my diet!
9330027.n1: Sometimes I just want to take off and go somewhere far! Where should I go?

9330028.d0: I'm the owner of the Night Market fruit stand.
9330028.n0: Fruit always taste better when it's in season. Hahaha...
9330028.n1: Whew... I'm getting too old for this line of work.

9330029.name: Yoo Yoo
9330029.n0: I have everything you'll ever need! Take a look!
9330029.n1: It's dangerous to venture outside of the Night Market. Potions are a necessity for dangerous places.

9330030.n0: What you looking at? Just be on your way!
9330030.n1: I don't have to follow the rules. Besides, it's none of your business!

9330032.name: Fruit Stand Gramps
9330032.n0: Fruit always taste better when it's in season. Hahaha...
9330032.n1: Whew... I'm getting too old for this line of work.
